de.abas.ceks.jedp.query

Interface FieldListEnabledQuery

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    DatabaseCommandQuery, DatabaseQuery, DataQuery, DataTypeQuery, EDPQueryDescriptor, EnumerationItemQuery, EnumerationQuery, FieldQuery, FieldRelatedEDPQueryDescriptor, GroupQuery, InfosystemQuery, KeyQuery, MessageQuery, ProcedureExecutionQuery, ProcedureQuery, ReadRecordQuery, ReferenceInfoQuery, TableQuery, TestFieldValueQuery, TypedCommandQuery, VariableReferenceTypeQuery

    public interface FieldListEnabledQuery
    Interface to indicate that a query descriptor class is field list enabled. With field list enabled queries you can use a custom field list to retrieve only fields really required.
    NOTE: Starting with abas ERP version 2017r4, all query types are field list enabled.
    Author:
    male

    • Method Detail

      • setResultFieldList

        FieldListEnabledQuery setResultFieldList(FieldList fieldList)
        Sets the result field list for a query. Only these fields will be available in the resulting EDPQueryResult.
        NOTE: When setting the result field list, you MUST NOT use the field number constants from EDPConstants.
        Parameters:
        fieldList - the field list to be set
        Returns:
        this object

      • getResultFieldList

        Returns:
        the result field list if set, else null
